descriptions.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]的政界中逐渐壮大。他们自称§H[Root.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]稚嫩的政界中浮出水面。他们自称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: A new faction has emerged in the nascent political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保我们对星系其他区域的军事统治。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for us to assert our military dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于使用我们武器库中所有强大的强化体武器来统治星系的其余部分。
descriptions.en: Their members are committed to wielding every formidable, augmented weapon in our arsenal to assert dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员倡议关闭边境并且对星系事务保持不干涉原则。
descriptions.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders and non-interference with galactic affairs.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员提倡封闭边界，创造一个不受机器和其他星系实体干扰的社会。
descriptions.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders, and a society free of interference from machines and other galactic entities.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于我们帝国境内所有居民的平等与公正。
descriptions.en: Their members work for equality and justice for all denizens of our empire.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员寻求与星系邻居达成友好协议，以及为我们帝国的所有居民伸张正义。
descriptions.en: Their members seek friendly accord with our galactic neighbors and justice for all denizens of our empire.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于让国家专注于通过和平的手段来发展经济与维护社会稳定。
descriptions.en: Their members lobby for a national focus on financial growth and stability through peaceful means.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员游说通过和平手段实现商业增长和稳定，避免军国主义扩张。
descriptions.en: Their members lobby for mercantile growth and stability through peaceful means, free of militaristic augmentation.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的至高地位，有必要的可以缩减其他外星物种的权利。
descriptions.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, by curtailing the rights of aliens if necessary.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于维护[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的优先地位，用我们自己生产的强大机械加以增强。
descriptions.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, augmented by formidable machines of our own making.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学进步与成就。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for the advancement of the sciences.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学的进步以及对自身强化件的理解。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for advancement of the sciences, and better understanding of our augments.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动一个极端集权的政治体系的出现以及提高军事权威。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of political and military power.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员一直致力于推动主权政治权力和军事力量的极端集中，尽可能效仿我们所知的机械智能。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of sovereign political power and military might, modelled on what we know of Machine Intelligences.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念。
descriptions.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念，与我们过去自然、有机的理念相一致。
descriptions.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values, many of which align with theories about our natural, organic past.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系，摆脱过去机械意识留下的阴影。
descriptions.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species, unburdened by the specter of our Machine past.

descriptions.zh: 他们的成员在各种无政府议题上表达了五彩缤纷的抗议，要求建立一个更富表达和平等的社会。
descriptions.en: Their members have sparked colorful protests on various anarchic issues, demanding a more expressive and egalitarian society.

descriptions.zh: 其成员倡导心灵主义价值，颂扬艰苦与忍耐。体能试炼在其社会中占重要地位。
descriptions.en: Their members promote spiritualist values, praising hardship and the ability to suffer through it. Physical trials play a significant role in their society.

descriptions.zh: 要求得不到满足的派系会成为麻烦的源头，而支持帝国工作的派系可以为我们所用……
descriptions.en: A disgruntled faction will be a source of trouble, but one that approves of the government's actions could prove useful...

descriptions.zh:
既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在§Y[root.GetName]§!建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。

我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
descriptions.en:
Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on §Y[root.GetName]§!. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.

Our analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.

label.zh: 应当赞许这种热烈的议论！
label.en: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!

label.zh: 密切关注这些活动人士。
label.en: Keep a close watch on these activists.
The risks are too great. Bolster security.

label.zh: 我们不能容忍这种情况。

descriptions.zh:
按照指示，我们在[root.GetName]的线人一直在定期汇报殖民地政治局势的最新进展。简而言之：前景向好。

地方执法者和政治代理人设法用最少的资源把公开异见控制在了最低限度。尤其是流氓派系，没能在殖民者那里占到一丁点好处。结果是我们仍然牢牢地控制着政治生态。
descriptions.en:
As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.

Local enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.

descriptions.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治局势的数据，证实了我们的许多担忧。激进的边缘性运动已经成功地在殖民地的人口中获得支持。这些公民已经被社会公平和流动性的说教所动摇，并且不再认同我们社会的一些基本原则。

尽管场面不太好看，但这仍然是个好消息。我们已经积累了大量的研究，对于完善我们的[owner.GetAdj]殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们诱导了这些边缘因素，让它们在首都站稳脚跟前就自己暴露了出来。
descriptions.en:
The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.

Despite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.

descriptions.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治运动的信息，得出了一些有趣的展望。我们发现当地对新思想的包容度正在提升（超出了我们先前认定的稳定的政治思想），但没有离经叛道之举。

尽管任何偏离我们核心思想的行为都可以说是削弱了我们的权力基础，但这仍然能算是个好消息。这次试验相当于一个实际的研究样本，对于我们完善殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们已经证明，即便给予边缘因素一定的政治土壤，[owner.GetAdj]的人民也会批驳他们当中最激进的成分，并相对地向我们国家的原则靠拢。
descriptions.en:
The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.

Though any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.

label.en: These patriots are to be commended.

label.zh: 或许……也许这种想法有一定可取之处？
label.en: Or... perhaps there is some merit to this thinking?

descriptions.zh:
我们的政治学家一直抱着热烈的兴趣观测着[root.GetName]。然而，尽管近期掀起了激烈的竞选活动，媒体还对此大肆渲染，他们仍预计该殖民地的政治走向会是相当典型的结果。

我们的研究人员注意到，这里“没有消息”就等于是好消息：尽管我们社会中的一些边缘分子发表了声明，但目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]正在被塑造成独裁的温床。目前，民主仍然是这里的一项基础性原则。
descriptions.en:
Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.

Our researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.

descriptions.zh: 似乎我们社会之中的一些威权主义政治组织在[root.GetName]上生根发芽。他们的许多游说活动都把目标对准了这个蓬勃发展的殖民地；此外，尽管他们明显的成功尚未引起人们的警醒：我们的政治学家却认为需要对此抱持谨慎态度。对于[root.GetName]的[root.owner.GetAdj]而言，民主并非如同我们一开始想象的那样，是那么的重要或具有吸引力。
descriptions.en: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.

descriptions.zh:
我们的政治学家对[root.GetName]进行了一段时间的监控，他们的报告证实当地存在着多种政治主张。

目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]会陷入无政府状态，也没有类似模式的极端治理方式。然而，这种政治冷漠行为确实为[root.owner.GetAdj]的民主带来了一些独特的挑战——以及潜在风险，如果更极端的派系在此扎根的话。
descriptions.en:
Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.

There are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.

label.zh: 或许我们应该进行干涉。
label.en: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.

label.zh: 对于我们的治国之道，这是颇有价值的检验！
label.en: A worthy test for our way of governance!

tooltips.zh: §Y政治热点§!修正将会持续大约§Y9§!年，提高思潮转化几率§G+50%§!。
tooltips.en: The §YPolitical Frontier§! modifier will remain for approximately §Y9§! years, increasing Ethics Shift Chance by §G+50%§!.

label.zh: 我们必须保护民主制度远离这类威胁。
label.en: We must guard against threats to democracy.

descriptions.zh:
第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。

尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。
descriptions.en:
Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, and demand adaptations to accommodate a future reshaped by this revelation.

Though non-violent, the sheer scale of these movements has placed a strain on civic services and disrupted daily life. However, many citizens do not see these protests as mere disorder. They see them as a reckoning, a sign that our very identity is being rewritten before our eyes.

label.zh: 让团结的集会走上街头。
label.en: Flood the streets with unity rallies.

label.zh: 将其说成是一种注意力分散。

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的示威来得快去得也快。现在许多人把矛头指向了§H宣泄派§!，这个以挑战社会规范的挑衅性作品而闻名的神秘团体。虽然他们的参与尚未得到证实，但他们最新的作品都集中在所谓的第一次接触的后果上，这加剧了争议和动荡。

虽然示威已经结束，但是§H宣泄派§!依然存在。他们的信息广为流传、影响持久。现在是决定我们如何应对的时候了。
descriptions.en:
The protests on [Root.GetName] have ceased almost as suddenly as they began. Many now point to §HThe Manifesti§!, a shadowy collective known for provocative works that challenge societal norms. While their involvement remains unconfirmed, their latest projects have fixated on the alleged consequences of first contact, fueling both controversy and unrest.

Though the demonstrations have ended, §HThe Manifesti§! remain. Their message spreads, their influence lingers. The time has come to decide how we respond.

label.zh: 把他们的作品熔成资源。
label.en: Melt down the projects for resources.

label.zh: 宣布他们是虚空的使者。
label.en: Declare them messengers of the void.

label.zh: 找到他们的家人然后拘留起来。

tooltips.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动
tooltips.en: the arrests killing off the movement

tooltips.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动，但激起了不满和破坏
tooltips.en: the arrests killing off the movement but also triggering civil unrest and devastation

descriptions.zh:
§H宣泄派§!不会再给我们添麻烦了。快速而强硬的镇压粉碎了这场运动，使组织四分五裂，信息噤声。他们所谓的“艺术”也被取缔了，领袖消失不见。

秩序恢复了，人们下次见到这种鲁莽的意识形态时会三思而后行。
descriptions.en:
§HThe Manifesti§! will trouble us no longer. A swift and decisive crackdown has dismantled their movement, scattering their members and silencing their message. Their so-called 'art' has been seized, their leaders disappeared.

Order is restored, and the people will think twice before embracing such reckless ideology again.

descriptions.zh: 感情没有价值，但资源有价值。宣泄派的所谓“项目”已经被没收、拆除，并被重新用于更有意义的地方。随着他们的集会点消失，这场运动失去了动力。
descriptions.en: Sentiment holds no value, but resources do. The so-called 'projects' of the Manifesti has been confiscated, dismantled, and repurposed for more practical use. With their rallying points gone, the movement has lost momentum.

descriptions.zh: §H宣泄派§!的反抗不仅仅是叛逆，而是一种标志，是一条来自虚空本身的信息。我们应该倾听，而不是让他们噤声。他们的一位成员已经被选中加入我们的政府，将享受最舒适的生活，因为是他们引导我们才对宇宙有了更深的理解。
descriptions.en: §HThe Manifesti's§! defiance is no mere rebellion but a sign, a message from the void itself. Rather than silence them, we shall listen. One among them has been chosen to join our governance, where they will enjoy the finest comforts as they guide us toward a deeper understanding of the cosmos.

descriptions.zh:
只要失去了言语载体，反对意见便无法传播。关闭了行星范围通讯后，我们切断了这些反对者的协调能力。没有了外部势力的引导，他们的运动很快就会崩溃。

不幸的是，通讯关闭也影响了执法部门完成任务的能力。
descriptions.en:
Dissent cannot spread if there is no voice to carry it. By shutting down planetary communications, we have severed the protesters' ability to coordinate. Without guidance from foreign elements, their movement is sure to collapse.

Unfortunately, the communications shutdown has also impacted the ability of law enforcement to perform its duties.

descriptions.zh:
持不同意见也是家事。我们通过拘留主要煽动者的亲属来迫使§H宣泄派§!屈服。他们的意志被打破后，领头人也被拘留了，这场运动已经崩溃。

秩序恢复了，我们的权威不容置疑。
descriptions.en:
Dissent is a family matter. By detaining the relatives of key agitators, we have forced §HThe Manifesti§! into submission. With their will broken and their leaders in custody, the movement has collapsed.

Order is restored, and our authority stands unquestioned.

descriptions.zh:
展览被悄悄拆除，创作者受到谴责，更具煽动性的作品被没收。我们通过官方渠道向其他国家保证，这种破坏性的言论并不反映我们的国家政策。

虽然一些人谴责此举是文字狱，但大多数人现在明白了一个简单的事实。如果威胁到了帝国的稳定，言论自由就要受到限制。
descriptions.en:
The exhibition was quietly dismantled, its creators reprimanded, and its more inflammatory pieces confiscated. Official channels assured our alien counterparts that such disruptive rhetoric does not reflect state policy.

While some decry the move as censorship, most now understand a simple truth. There are limits to free expression when the stability of the empire is at stake.

descriptions.zh: §H宣泄派§!的家人们被拘留了，而运动的领头人也因此很快被镇压。然而，公众的反应却不是顺从，而是愤怒。抗议活动愈演愈烈，不再局限于单纯的示威，而是演变为暴力骚乱。
descriptions.en: The families of §HThe Manifesti§! have been detained, and with them, the movement's leadership has been effectively neutralized. Yet, instead of compliance, the public's response has been one of outrage. Protests have grown fiercer, no longer confined to mere demonstrations but erupting into violent unrest.

label.zh: 希望这样一场闹剧就此结束。
label.en: Let us hope that's the end of such nonsense.

descriptions.zh:
一种人为制造的语言开始在艺术中心和学术机构传播，这是对官方语言的刻意拒绝。这种由§H宣泄派§!创造的语言的使用者拒绝承认我们语言的合法性，认为它是不过一种在第一次接触之后就无法自诩正统的社会符号。

行政官们警告称，越来越多的人拒绝以既定的方式进行沟通，这可能会加深分歧，破坏公共话语的稳定。
descriptions.en:
A fabricated language has begun spreading through art centers and academic institutions, a deliberate rejection of the official tongue. Created by §HThe Manifesti§!, its speakers refuse to acknowledge the legitimacy of our language, seeing it as a symbol of a society that can no longer define itself in the wake of first contact.

Officials warn that this growing refusal to communicate in established terms risks deepening divisions and destabilizing public discourse.

descriptions.zh:
§H宣泄派§!已经公布了他们最为公开的展览的日期。这是一次位于[this.GetName]的全新且极其受欢迎的互动体验，邀请参观者操控他们自己的反射镜像，以及创造由扭曲的政治人物形象组成的拼贴画——其中一些甚至来自于§H其他的星际帝国§!。

批评家们认为这些画作是我们对自己自我感的一次必要和严厉的审视。这次展览还激发了许多其他形式的讽刺艺术，其主题涵盖诸多国内议题和泛物种关系。

我们的社会研究者掀起了激烈的讨论；一些保守的声音要求我们谨慎处理。
descriptions.en:
§HThe Manifesti§! have unveiled their most public exhibition to date. A new and extremely popular interactive experience on [this.GetName] invites visitors to manipulate reflections and images of themselves, and to create distorted collages of political figures - some from §Hother galactic empires§!.

Critics herald these pieces as casting a necessarily and harsh light upon our sense of self. The exhibition has also inspired a number of other satirical works both on domestic issues, and on pan-species relations.

Debate amongst our social researchers is lively; more conservative voices urge caution.

label.zh: 这简直就是一次外交灾难的前夕。赶紧全部封杀。
label.en: A diplomatic disaster waiting to happen. Shut them down.

descriptions.zh: 关于所谓的“宣泄主义”启发了一个全新派系形成的留言四起。随着我们在第一次接触后对宇宙和自身在其中地位的理解的陷入质疑，它的支持者们开始挑战既定的规范。他们提倡激进的自我表达和对社会结构的根本重新评估。现有的派系抱怨称自己的集会受到了宣泄派煽动者的干扰，这些人对政府的无情挑战正在[Root.GetName]播下不和的种子。
descriptions.en: Rumors spread that a new faction is emerging, driven by the ideals of 'Manifestism.' In the aftermath of first contact, as our understanding of the universe and our place within it comes into question, its proponents challenge established norms. They advocate for radical self-expression and a fundamental reevaluation of societal structures. Existing factions complain that their gatherings are being disrupted by Manifestist agitators, whose relentless challenges to governance are sowing discord across [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
§Y宣泄派§!发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。

尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。
descriptions.en:
The buzz surrounding §YThe Manifesti§! faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.

Attendance at galleries and museums has never been higher, but the public gaze has already moved on to newer, controversial groups of artists. We will continue to sift through the data gathered during this strange moment in [root.GetAdj] cultural history.

label.zh: 生活还是要继续的，没办法。
